mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed Marshall Islands registered agent / corporate service provider

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence for all directors, officers, UBOs, and signatories against the UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN and Non-SDN Lists, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HMT sanctions list, and the domestic Marshall Islands sanctions and restricted-persons list administered by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) include heads of state, senior politicians, senior judicial officials, senior military officers, and board members of central banks; immediate family and known close associates are subject to automatic enhanced monitoring. The registered agent must apply risk-based procedures: full name and alias screening using fuzzy matching, date-of-birth verification, negative news review, and source-of-funds/source-of-wealth verification. Any sanction or PEP match requires escalation to the Marshall Islands Financial Intelligence Unit before incorporation is permitted. While the transaction is treated as low AML-risk (standard) under ISIC 5229 reverse logistics, the UBO register must be updated within 14 days of any change in beneficial ownership.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Marshall Islands Registrar of Corporations Online Name Reservation Portal (accessed exclusively through licensed registered agents; direct public access not available for non-resident corporations)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be submitted in Latin script using the 26 letters of the English alphabet. Arabic numerals, punctuation marks, and permissible symbols may be used subject to Registrar guidelines. The name must contain a corporate suffix: 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Limited', or an abbreviation thereof ('Corp.', 'Inc.', 'Ltd.'). Foreign names must be romanized according to the standard transliteration doctrine adopted by the Registrar and must not include diacritical marks. A certified English translation of any non-English name element is required at the time of filing.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If name clearance is rejected, the applicant's registered agent must file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of Corporations within 14 days of the rejection notice. The appeal must state the statutory basis for availability under Section 26 of the Business Corporations Act, identify any conflicting names, and provide supporting evidence. The Registrar must issue a final written decision within 15 business days. If the rejection is upheld, the applicant may file a further appeal to the Marshall Islands High Court within 30 days of the Registrar's final decision. A single automatic extension of the name reservation may be requested before expiry for a further 30-day period if filing of incorporation documents is pending, subject to payment of the statutory extension fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Accepted with conditions: The Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act requires every corporation to maintain a registered office and registered agent physically located in the Marshall Islands. A virtual office address is permissible as an administrative address for correspondence, statutory notices, and mail forwarding, but it does not supplant the statutory registered agent requirement. For ISIC 5229 reverse logistics operations, the company may conduct all substantive operational activities outside the Marshall Islands while maintaining only the registered agent office locally. Virtual office arrangements are generally accepted for non-resident corporations, but the company must keep accurate records accessible through its registered agent; shell-company indicators are mitigated by the legitimate reverse-logistics business purpose and the appointment of a licensed registered agent.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (5% annual probability): For a non-resident, tax-exempt Marshall Islands Business Corporation engaged solely in cross-border reverse logistics and returned-goods quantity grading, unannounced physical on-site inspections of the registered agent's office are possible under AML/CFT supervision but uncommon unless triggered by a suspicious transaction report, sanctions hit, or regulatory complaint. Physical inspection of the company's actual foreign operational premises is essentially not applicable because those premises fall outside Marshall Islands territorial jurisdiction. If the company later establishes physical presence in the Marshall Islands, the inspection likelihood would increase to approximately 20% under the risk-based supervisory framework.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act, Title 27 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code; Sections 31 (Articles of Incorporation), 38 (Registered Office and Agent) and 45 (Organization Meeting)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands Business Registry, Majuro; corporate filings are lodged through a licensed Marshall Islands registered agent
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; no escrow account or capital depository rule applies. Subscribers may issue shares for lawful consideration determined by the Board, and non-resident ownership is expressly permitted in full.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the incorporator's actions in preparing and filing the Corporation's Articles of Incorporation under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act are hereby ratified; that the subscription of One Hundred (100) shares of Common Stock by the initial subscriber be, and the same is, accepted for lawful consideration; that the registered office be fixed at the office of the appointed registered agent in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands; that the Bylaws submitted are adopted; that the named individuals are appointed initial President, Secretary and Treasurer; that bank signatories and custodians are established; and that officers are directed to complete statutory filings and obtain all operational clearances.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Registered Agent Engagement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, RMI Business Registry (online portal through licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed Marshall Islands registered agent; submit the name reservation application electronically with a corporate name that is distinguishable from all existing entities; receive a reservation certificate for the reverse logistics corporation.
required_dossiers: Registered Agent Consent to Serve (Form RA-20)
Proof of registered agent's licensed address in Majuro, RMI
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is deemed confusingly similar, file a revised reservation with a substituted name or file a written administrative reconsideration; the Registry may reallocate the fee to the resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Notarization and Pre-Filing Vetting of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered Agent and Notary Public authorized under Marshall Islands law
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare Articles of Incorporation in English specifying the corporate name, primary purpose covering cross-border reverse logistics and returned goods quality grading (ISIC 5229), registered office and agent, authorized shares, and non-resident Business Corporation status. Notarize the incorporator's signature and obtain the registered agent's countersignature.
required_dossiers: Corporate Purpose Statement and ISIC 5229 scope description
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any ministerial omission, re-notarize the signature page and re-submit the vetted package through the registered agent before final Registry filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing and Payment of State Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, RMI Business Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Electronically file the exact-vetted Articles of Incorporation, pay the official state filing fee, track acceptance and obtain the filed-stamped Articles together with the Certificate of Incorporation.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a query on the filing, respond within seven calendar days with a covering letter and corrected Articles; expedited resubmission may be used if a certification deadline is imminent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Meeting and First Board Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors or Sole Incorporator acting by unanimous written consent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct the organizational meeting in Majuro or by unanimous written consent; adopt the Bylaws; appoint the initial President, Secretary and Treasurer; approve the share subscription and issuance; fix the registered office and agent; authorize banking and routine operational mandates.
required_dossiers: Written Consent of Incorporator or Organizational Minutes
First Board Resolution and Officer Appointment Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a records defect is identified, pass a temporary ratification resolution and an omnibus correction consent to validate corporate actions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Corporate Records and Good Standing Certification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Registry Services Counter, RMI Business Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File any post-registration designations, verify the official Certificate of Incorporation, and request a Certificate of Good Standing and confirmation of non-resident status exemption. Maintain the corporate records book at the registered office.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Good Standing Application (Form GS-10)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If official records contain a mismatch, file a Registry data amendment request through the registered agent and re-apply for corrected certificates with expedited handling.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: RMI Environmental Protection Authority, Inspection and Compliance Division
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: General Facility Operating Permit for Reverse Logistics and Warehouse Operations (Non-Hazardous Activity Registration)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority, Republic of the Marshall Islands
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 — Pollution Registration and Environmental Notification; no full EIA required provided the facility does not receive, store or treat hazardous waste or undertake metal smelting/chemical processing
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero untreated process wastewater discharge; stormwater runoff controls consistent with RMIEPA Water Quality Standards; ambient air particulate limits under the RMI Clean Air Regulations; all returned merchandise must be segregated, free from hazardous material, and have customs/container clearance documentation on file.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification and emergency evacuation plan approved by the Majuro Fire Department; structural load inspection certificate for racking, mezzanine and heavy storage areas; workplace safety clearance from the RMI Occupational Safety and Health Division covering manual handling, equipment guarding and incident-response preparedness.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Revenue and Taxation Authority (RTA) of the Republic of the Marshall Islands, operating under the Ministry of Finance, Banking and Postal Services; online tax services via the RTA e-Services portal (rta.rmi); customs administration through the RMI Customs Service on the ASYCUDA World electronic single-window platform.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Under the Revenue and Taxation Administration Act 2014, a TIN is mandatory only for persons deriving assessable income from RMI sources. A non-resident Business Corporation (BC) with no RMI-source income and no RMI trade or business is not required to file income-tax registration; where a bank or counterparty requires a TIN, the BC's Registered Agent files the RTA registration application with the Certificate of Incorporation, Articles of Incorporation, Bylaws, and a director's certificate of non-residency, obtaining an RMI TIN expeditiously. No VAT ID exists because the RMI imposes no VAT/GST. If the BC handles physical goods entering the RMI, it must additionally register as an importer with the RMI Customs Service and obtain an ASYCUDA identifier for customs (import tax) purposes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No U.S.-style check-the-box regime exists in the Republic of the Marshall Islands. A domestic BC incorporated under the Business Corporations Act may voluntarily elect non-resident corporation status by filing a Non-Resident Domestic Corporation declaration with the Registrar of Corporations through its Registered Agent, thereby confining RMI income-tax exposure strictly to RMI-source income. RMI law provides no hybrid-mismatch elections; the entity's classification for foreign tax purposes is governed by the foreign jurisdiction and has no independent RMI tax effect.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT / No GST / No Sales and Use Tax — the Republic of the Marshall Islands levies no national value-added, goods-and-services, or sales-and-use tax; the only border indirect charge is the RMI Import Tax (generally 2% ad valorem under the National Revenue Act 1990) and specific environmental/fuel surcharges applicable to physical imports.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — no VAT/GST turnover threshold exists. Income-tax registration is triggered by derivation of income sourced within the RMI (territorial-source principle) or by carrying on a trade or business in the RMI, regardless of turnover; customs import-tax registration arises on any physical importation into the RMI with no minimum turnover threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, e-invoicing, or digital stamping mandate exists for RMI taxpayers. RMI Customs requires electronic declaration processing through the ASYCUDA World single window (customs export/import declarations, commercial invoices, and bills of lading/air waybills must be filed electronically). The RTA e-Services portal supports voluntary online income-tax and withholding-tax filing and payment; no API-based fiscal invoice clearance is imposed on offshore reverse-logistics service providers.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: VAT zero-rating does not apply because no VAT is imposed. The non-resident BC instead obtains de facto 0% RMI tax on cross-border reverse-logistics and returned-goods grading by satisfying: (i) all services physically performed outside the RMI and remunerated by non-resident principals, so income is non-RMI-source; (ii) no office, warehouse, agent, or permanent establishment inside the RMI; (iii) revenue derived solely from offshore fulfillment and grading operations; and (iv) no RMI importation or local market sale of goods. Where returned merchandise physically transits an RMI port in bond for re-export, the Import Tax does not apply under the transit/export-drawback provisions of the National Revenue Act 1990.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: RMI Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World) for any goods physically exported or re-exported from RMI territory
Bill of Lading or Master Air Waybill evidencing the international movement of returned merchandise from an RMI port (Majuro or Ebeye) to the foreign destination
Inward Remittance Certificate issued by an RMI-licensed bank, or correspondent-bank FX credit advice, evidencing the actual receipt of export proceeds in the RMI where repatriation is required
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Because the RMI has no VAT, fraudulent export zero-rating claims are inapplicable; however, false representations to obtain non-resident exemption, import-tax drawback, or transit/bond relief are subject to: (i) RTA audit under the Revenue and Taxation Administration Act 2014, including reopening of returns and issuance of protective assessments; (ii) retrospective clawback of any exemption, drawback, or refund improperly obtained, plus statutory interest and late-payment penalties; (iii) monetary penalties and forfeiture of goods under the Customs Act 1991 for customs declaration inaccuracies; and (iv) criminal prosecution of the entity and its officers for tax evasion or perjury in the event of fraudulent documentation, carrying fines and imprisonment.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) has no conventional central bank. Prudential supervision is exercised by the Banking Commissioner of the Ministry of Finance under the Banking Act 1999 (as amended); AML/CFT supervision is vested in the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act. The U.S. dollar (USD) is the sole legal tender, with monetary policy and currency issuance effectively delegated to the U.S. Federal Reserve pursuant to the RMI Currency Act and the Compact of Free Association.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Current-account and capital-account transactions are fully convertible; there are no exchange controls, no convertibility licensing, and no withholding or remittance tax for a Non-Resident Business Corporation (BC). Profit distributions, share-capital returns, and liquidation proceeds may be transferred freely. The only material hurdles are correspondent-bank OFAC/FATCA screening and enhanced due diligence arising from RMI's presence on the EU List of Non-Cooperative Jurisdictions; FATCA exposure is neutralized by the BC's Active NFFE W-8BEN-E status.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory timeline and no mandatory conversion ratio apply. RMI law does not require surrender, repatriation, or mandatory conversion of export proceeds; receipts from reverse-logistics grading, recovered-merchandise sales, and logistics fees may be retained indefinitely in USD or any offshore currency without filing.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium_Feasibility with mandatory legal safeguards. Airwallex, the designated target rail, is not licensed in the RMI and cannot provide a local Majuro settlement account; onboarding proceeds through the Hong Kong/Singapore/Australia entities using the certificate of incorporation, registered-agent certificate, franchise tax receipt, UBO register, W-8BEN-E (Active NFFE), and a 12-month cash-flow model. Because the RMI is on the EU List of Non-Cooperative Jurisdictions, Airwallex applies enhanced review, but the designated Low_Risk_Standard AML tier of ISIC 5229 reverse logistics avoids automatic declines. A dual-rail structure is mandatory: the BOMI operational account retains the liquidity anchor (minimum USD 50,000) while Airwallex executes local-US ACH collection and FX conversion; no RMI regulatory approval is required for using an offshore EMI, but the board must pre-authorize throughput limits and quarterly reconciliation to BOMI.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The Banking Act 1999 and the Financial Transactions Reporting Act do not prescribe an in-person appearance; however, BOMI's compliance practice requires at least one physical visit by a director/signatory to the Majuro branch for account activation, and mandatory physical attendance of the ultimate beneficial owner for any capital-escrow arrangement. Remote onboarding is available only via a licensed RMI registered agent that delivers a director-introduction letter, apostilled notarized board resolutions, and certified passport copies; the agent's video-KYC channel may be accepted but remains discretionary to BOMI's compliance committee.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident tax-exempt corporation domiciled in an EU-listed non-cooperative jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of good standing; registered-agent certificate; full text of the Business Corporations Act tax-exemption for non-resident domestic corporations (proving the EU listing is a tax-policy artifact); APG mutual-evaluation summary and OECD Global Forum exchange-of-information rating (RMI is not on the FATF high-risk or grey lists); RMI economic-substance declaration; executed reverse-logistics contracts and financial statements evidencing real cross-border operation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque or bearer-share ownership structure typical of offshore vehicles
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Restated articles and complete share register showing registered shares only; UBO declaration for all individuals with 10% or greater ownership, with passport copies; corporate-ownership chart prepared by the registered agent; if bearer shares exist, custody confirmation from an authorized financial institution and an irrevocable board resolution converting them to registered form before account opening.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume, low-value refund and chargeback traffic disproportionate to declared revenue
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed marketplace and 3PL fulfillment agreements; granular RMA-to-refund reconciliation dataset; 12-month cash-flow projection with projected refund ratios; ISIC 5229 grading and condition reports documenting value-add; board resolution segregating customer refunds within the operational account and prohibiting use of capital escrow for refunds.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporation Report (Standard Annual Franchise Tax Filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary-based; due on or before October 1 immediately following the fiscal year end, or the date designated by the registered agent in the corporate renewal notice
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty equal to 10% of the unpaid annual fee per month or part thereof; continued delinquency for more than 6 months may result in administrative strike-off and loss of good standing certificate

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent Annual License Confirmation and Address Verification
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Marshall Islands Registrar of Corporations (via licensed resident agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Concurrent with the Annual Corporation Report; typically October 1 of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to confirm registered agent and office may trigger cancellation of corporate charter under Section 104 of the Business Corporations Act; recurring noncompliance leads to involuntary dissolution

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Economic Substance or Business Activities Declaration (if within a regulated sector)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Marshall Islands Registrar and/or Ministry of Finance (applicable only where economic substance legislation applies)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months of the entity's financial year end, where triggered by non-exempt business activities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Not generally applicable to pure reverse logistics non-resident entities; if incorrectly triggered, late filing penalties and mandatory deregistration may apply under applicable economic substance regulations

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Information Confirmation to Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Marshall Islands Registered Agent (enforcement by Registrar of Corporations)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No fixed statutory date; must be provided within 7 days of any ownership change and at least annually with the Annual Corporation Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain accurate beneficial ownership records with the registered agent may result in financial penalties of up to $5,000 and, in cases of intentional default, disqualification or conviction under the Business Corporations Act

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory independent audit is imposed under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act for a non-resident Business Corporation; a statutory audit is required only if the entity is listed, is a public interest entity, or has been expressly ordered by the Registrar or court; otherwise audits are triggered by commercial lenders, insurers, or joint-venture agreements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) or IFRS for SMEs accepted; local Generally Accepted Accounting Principles are only recognized as an equivalent where no statutory audit applies; accounting records must fairly reflect financial condition and transactions.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No public UBO register is maintained in the Marshall Islands. The registered agent must obtain and retain adequate beneficial ownership information, including the legal chain of ownership and identification details for each essential beneficial owner. The annual confirmation must update all shareholders, directors, and ultimate beneficial owners; any transfer of shares requires a board resolution, updated register of members, and notification to the registered agent within 7 days of the transfer.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Charges or Encumbrances (if any)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US $350 – $900 per annum (standard resident agent plus registered office package)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US $4,000 – $12,000 per annum (only if outsourced audit is contractually required)

stage_6.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (no Marshall Islands corporate income tax; non-resident domestic corporations are tax-exempt on worldwide income)
stage_6.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Non-resident domestic BCs are outside the RMI income tax, business license tax, gross revenue tax, capital gains tax, and branch remittance tax base. The only fixed annual cost is the Registrar's maintenance fee. No VAT/GST or payroll tax for offshore entities.
